name: Richey Capacitor Inc.
old_description: R. Royce Richey entered in the electronics industry in 1954 and was influential in the design and development of the subminiature electrolytic capacitor for the US market. He founded the company in 1965, and Richey is still one of the most recognizable names in the electronic industry.
about:
Richey Capacitor Inc. is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. The company was founded in 1965 by R. Royce Richey, who had entered the electronics industry in 1954 and played a key role in developing the subminiature electrolytic capacitor for the U.S. market.

The company manufactures and markets aluminum electrolytic and film capacitors. Its product line includes computer-grade, snap-in, and through-hole aluminum electrolytic capacitors, as well as dipped and box-type film capacitors. Richey leverages manufacturing facilities in China and Taiwan, and provides custom part-number data sheets, samples, and extensive technical support to design engineers, purchasing agents, and distributors.

Richey serves the broader electronics industry and has built long-term relationships with companies such as Franklin Electric, Paul C Buff, QSC Audio, Aclara, Astronics Electronic Solutions, United Technologies, and Robertshaw Controls. Its customers span audio equipment, aerospace, industrial controls, and smart infrastructure sectors.

Richey emphasizes its thorough technical knowledge of capacitor technology, combined with advanced manufacturing capabilities from its overseas facilities. The company cites constant development of new materials and processes, along with a personal level of customer service and complete product information, as factors that have made it a successful American supplier for over 50 years.
